fantasy: I am controlling a legendary Titan, alone, against an impossible battlefield.
pillars: Roster mastery instead of party composition
completeCombatLoop: Choose one Titan after reading mission type, terrain, enemies, boss, and modifiers.
Enter tactical battlefield with objective, enemy intents, terrain hazards, Momentum 0, Divinity 0, selected stance.
Player turn: move, basic attack, technique, stance shift, environmental action, execution, or Divine Ascension if ready.
Enemy turn: coordinated AI acts against one powerful target, telegraphing threats and creating reaction windows.
Reaction windows interrupt enemy resolution without becoming real-time combat.
Momentum rises through aggressive intelligent mastery and falls through poor positioning or passivity.
Divinity rises through mythic performance and powers Ascendant stance/Divine Ascension.
Terrain and destructible objects alter movement, damage, enemy AI, and Titan-specific mechanics.
Victory comes from objective completion, boss defeat, escape, ritual control, or survival state; not always enemy wipe.

turnStructure.round: Player Phase -> Enemy Intent Reveal -> Enemy Phase with Reaction Windows -> Terrain/Hazard Tick -> Objective Evaluation -> Round Advance
turnStructure.enemyPhase: Enemies execute coordinated behaviors; each major enemy action can expose one contextual reaction prompt.
turnStructure.noRealtimeRule: Reaction choices are turn-based prompts with clear limits and costs.

movement.base: Titan movement uses speed, size, terrain cost, engagement zones, and stance modifiers.
movement.soloDifference: Movement is survival, offense, and resource generation at once; there is no allied backline to save the Titan.

attacks.basic: Reliable identity-specific generator; not a generic Strike clone.
attacks.techniques: Cooldown/resource abilities that express archetype and unique mechanic.
attacks.signatures: High-impact Titan identity moment, usually spending Momentum and/or setup.
attacks.damagePipeline: Attack roll/seed -> accuracy/evasion/parry -> terrain/stance/status modifiers -> shields/mitigation -> damage -> vulnerability/execution check -> event log.

momentum.definition: The Titan gaining control of the battlefield.
momentum.designGoal: Reward aggressive intelligent play rather than passive waiting.

divinity.divineAscension: Spectacular temporary state that enhances abilities, changes battlefield rules, and creates unique victory windows.

reactions.costs: Usually Momentum, cooldown, stance condition, or Titan-specific resource.
reactions.limits: One default reaction per enemy phase unless Titan mastery, Guard stance, or unique mechanic expands it.
reactions.clarity: UI shows trigger, cost, likely outcome, and skip option.

Assault.tradeoff: lower mitigation and weaker brace reactions

Guard.tradeoff: lower damage and slower Divinity generation

Ascendant.benefit: divine techniques, mechanic amplification, battlefield impact
Ascendant.tradeoff: Divinity drain and post-Ascension vulnerability risk

stances.uniqueVariants: Individual Titans may rename or twist stances while preserving readability.

executions.vulnerability: Enemies become vulnerable at health thresholds, stagger states, broken guard, terrain trap, or failed cast.
executions.choice: Executing may spend action economy but grants Titan-specific payoff.

terrain.destruction: Pillars, walls, gates, shrines, cover, bridges, chains, roots, and ritual anchors can be broken when mission and Titan rules allow.

enemyAI.principle: Enemies know they are fighting one powerful opponent.

progression.antiInflation: Levels unlock versatility, resource control, reaction mastery, terrain options, and Ascension expression more than raw stat bloat.

examples: complete mission using required stance discipline
mastery.reward: Learning the Titan, not only increasing numbers.

phases: Phase 4 enrages or denies core resource
bossMechanics.rule: Bosses win through adaptation pressure, not enormous health pools alone.

campaignStructure.mission: Individual tactical battle with explicit solo purpose
campaignStructure.loreJustification: Unstable Gates allow Titans to cross where armies would be destroyed, scattered, or turned by realm pressure.

asynchronousPvp.name: Asynchronous Titan Challenge
asynchronousPvp.futureReady: Shared deterministic engine can later support live PvP without calling async real-time PvP.

futureReserveSystem.currentRule: Do not implement reserves in normal build.
futureReserveSystem.architecture: Allow fields for 1 active Titan + optional future reserve list; only one Titan ever appears at a time.

mobileUX.principle: Large touch targets, low clutter, Titan as visual focal point.

camera.boss: intro and phase-change shots without sacrificing tactical readability

samplePresets.name: Legacy Five-Titan Squad Baseline
samplePresets.purpose: QA reference only: confirms the old squad baseline is documented while active solo combat uses one selected Titan.
samplePresets.activeSoloRule: Only one Titan is active in solo combat.

sourceCultureAbilityRule: All basics, techniques, signatures, movement, reactions, executions, weapons, armor, and cores must express the selected Titan’s Realm as the older source behind Earth mythology.
